Subject: RidgeView private offering — procurement info & next steps

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to send the procurement pack and SOW we use for private plans so we can start redlines on our side. Attached are: RV-Redwood-POI-20270810.pdf (procurement info), and our standard SOW template (RidgeView_SOW_vTemplate.pdf).

High level asks from RidgeView:
- We need explicit DPA language for PHI handling and audit logging.
- Invoice routing must go to invoices@ridgeview.com and be net 60.
- We'd like entitlements to be tied to committed GPU-hours per month with a meter/usage report.

Can you confirm Redwood can provide an amendment for a private plan on Azure Marketplace (private offer) and whether you have an Azure metering feed we can use for reconciliation? Also please send point of contact for legal and billing.

Thanks,
Emily Park

Hi Emily — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Happy to run this through our Azure private plan flow. Quick answers up front:
- Yes, we can do a private plan (Azure private offer) with an amendment that adds tailored DPA language for PHI and audit log access.
- We support invoice routing to a customer billing email (net terms are handled via the sales contract — we can propose net 60).
- We can provide a metering feed from our usage pipeline tied to the private SKU; I'll confirm the exact export format with engineering.

Looping in Marissa (sales ops) for entitlements and subscription mapping, Irene (legal) for amendment/DPA redlines, and Ben (finance) for invoice/terms.

Proposed next steps:
1) RidgeView returns any initial redlines to the attached draft amendment (we'll circulate a Redwood draft if preferred).
2) Irene to flag any non-standard legal asks and suggest playbook language.
3) Marissa to confirm SKU entitlement mapping and committed hours model.
4) Ben to confirm net 60 viability and invoicing instructions.

If that works, I'll prepare a Redwood draft amendment (marked) and share by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Emily / team — thanks, looping in legal to get a first pass. I've reviewed the packet and drafted a starter amendment that maps the private plan SKU to an MSA amendment and includes DPA language for PHI (see attached: RV_Redwood_Draft_Amendment_v1.docx). A few items we need RidgeView to confirm or accept:

Key legal points needing confirmation:
- Data residency: Redwood can host customer data in Azure US regions. If RidgeView requires specific geo-isolation walled off to a named region, we need that in writing.
- PHI handling: Our standard DPA includes processor terms; if RidgeView requires Business Associate Agreement (BAA) language to be embedded in the amendment, please indicate the exact scope of PHI processed and any contractual templates you must adhere to.
- Audit logs & access: We can provide audit logs (request + 7 day SLA for export) and a redacted log feed suitable for security review. Please confirm the log retention window required.
- Metering & reconciliation: We will provide a monthly usage CSV export and an Azure Marketplace meter ID. Confirm whether RidgeView needs hourly granularity or daily aggregates.

I'll mark the clause positions and leave comments asking RidgeView to indicate preferred redlines (track changes preferred). If RidgeView needs any indemnity variations or specific IP exhibits, flag them early — those will require legal review cycles.

Attached: RV_Redwood_Draft_Amendment_v1.docx (draft marked)

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Thanks Irene — attached is RidgeView's completed procurement form and our PO template (RidgeView_Procurement_Form_20270811.pdf). A few points from RidgeView side:

- Data residency: US only, prefer West US region. That should be acceptable per your note.
- PHI / BAA: RidgeView requires BAA-equivalent language in the amendment; attached is the clause we usually ask vendors to adopt (see ProcForm section 4b).
- Audit logs: 90 day retention minimum, daily aggregates OK.
- Metering: daily aggregates are sufficient; we need a monthly CSV with daily rows and a marketplace meter ID for reconciliation.
- Billing: invoices to invoices@ridgeview.com, PO# RV-2027-5543, net 60.

We'd appreciate a Redwood-marked amendment with the BAA language embedded. Can you also confirm whether Azure Marketplace private offers support invoice delivery via partner-managed invoicing or whether Redwood will be the originator of the invoice?

- Billing: Invoice to invoices@ridgeview.com; PO# RV-2027-5543; Redwood proposes net 60. Ben will confirm internal approvals for net 60 and follow up separately.

2) RidgeView to review and return track-changes if any (expected review window 3 business days).
3) Once redlines converge, we'll issue a DocuSign package for the amendment + order form.
